title: Hamburger Buns
description: Soft, golden, and pillowy — the perfect base for your ultimate burger creations.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lukewarm milk, sugar, and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add bread flour, salt, and oil. Mix until a rough dough forms.
Knead for 8–10 minutes by hand or in a stand mixer until the dough is smooth, soft, and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1–1½ hours or until doubled in sise.
Punch down the dough and divide into 8 equal pieces, approximately 105–110 g each.
Shape each piece into a smooth ball by tucking the edges underneath, then flatten slightly into a disc shape.
Place buns on a lined baking tray, leaving space between each for expansion.
Cover and let rise for 45–60 minutes until puffy and nearly doubled.
Brush tops lightly with milk and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the tops are golden brown but still soft.
Cool on a wire rack before slicing horizontally for burgers.

notes.title: Perfect Shape
notes.content: For uniform buns, weigh each dough portion to ensure they are all the same sise — approximately 105–110 g each.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container for 2–3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Thaw and warm before using.

notes.title: Brioche-Style
notes.content: For richer, brioche-style buns, add 1 beaten egg to the dough and replace the oil with 40 g of melted unsalted butter.
